title: Observer Pattern
overview: Notify a list of dependents automatically when an object changes state.
useCases: Multiple objects need to react automatically to changes in another object
You want event-driven behaviour where the event producer is decoupled from consumers
The set of listeners may change dynamically at runtime
exampleUses: A spreadsheet where changing one cell automatically recalculates all dependent cells and refreshes the chart
A social media feed where followers receive a notification whenever someone they follow posts new content
A CI/CD pipeline where committing code triggers multiple independent jobs (build, test, lint) simultaneously
